constraints: If path designates a method that does not exist, it is created with the given code contents (project databases only: only database methods, triggers, and project methods can be newly created this way).

When called, the method's attributes are reset by default unless the first line of code contains valid JSON metadata (as generated by METHOD GET CODE), in which case that metadata sets the attributes and the first line is not inserted as code.
If called from a component you must pass the trailing '*' parameter, because access to the component code is read-only; omitting it in that context generates error -9763.

jointConstraints.rule: path and code must be passed as the same kind (both scalar Text variables, or both Text arrays of matching length); the two syntaxes cannot be mixed.
